intent: Export a sample-by-variant matrix with the number of copies of the ALT allele (0, 1 or 2) of each variant, for use in R.
silent_error: plink 1.9 re-assigns A1/A2 by frequency when it imports a VCF: A1 becomes the MINOR allele, not the ALT allele, unless --keep-allele-order is given. --recode A counts copies of A1, so at variants where the ALT allele is the major allele (rs3002, rs3004) the matrix holds REFERENCE-allele counts. Only the column header (e.g. rs3002_C) differs; no message, exit 0. Documented in plink --help (--keep-allele-order: keep the allele order instead of forcing A2 to be the major allele; --recode A counts A1).
